request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fur, fabric and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

This is an edit of image 1: the result must look like the same place photographed from the same spot. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 shows a tree on a grassy hill in a park in summer. Keep the same tree, hill, bench, path and framing. Change the season to FALL (autumn): every leaf on the tree is orange, red and yellow, many leaves are falling through the air and a thick carpet of fallen orange leaves covers the grass and the bench; the sky is pale and the light is low and golden. Remove the picnic blanket and the hat. No people. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
